code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(markers):
        for r2, c2 in markers[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
            if dr == 0:
                step = (0, 1 if dc > 0 else -1)
            elif dc == 0:
                step = (1 if dr > 0 else -1, 0)
            elif abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                step = (1 if dr > 0 else -1, 1 if dc > 0 else -1)
            else:
                continue
            r, c = r1 + step[0], c1 + step[1]
            while (r, c) != (r2, c2):
                if out[r][c] == background:
                    out[r][c] = 3
                r += step[0]; c += step[1]
    return out
'''
